adjudications.why: Solver answered IIT Madras from memory (MEDIUM). SWAYAM PRABHA's own channel allocation table (swayamprabha.gov.in/ch_allocation/he, read 2026-11-10) lists Channel 25, Humanities and Social Sciences, under IIT Kanpur, as NTA's key says. Key stays, solution rewritten.
adjudications.solution:
**SWAYAM PRABHA** is a group of DTH channels run by the Ministry of Education that telecast educational programmes round the clock. Each channel has a coordinating institution that provides its content.

The IITs coordinate several of the higher-education channels. **IIT Kanpur** looks after five of them, including Channel 25, **Humanities and Social Sciences** (its neighbours, Channel 24 on Aeronautical Engineering and Channel 26 on Management, Law and Economics, are IIT Kanpur's too).

So the answer is option (A).
